About Orchard
Orchard is transforming the way people buy and sell their homes. Simplifying it, to the way it should have always been; fair and true to market, straightforward, easy.  Every year in the U.S., $1.5 trillion of single family homes transact, generating over $120 billion of fees in a process that has changed little in decades. For the average American, the home purchase and sale process takes months, creates anxiety and is filled with uncertainty and hassle. Orchard offers a modern alternative, making one of life's biggest decisions -- the sale and purchase of a home –so stress free, fair and simple that people cannot imagine any other way. Orchard is headquartered in New York City, has 150+ employees, a network of 600 agents and has grown nearly 2x year over the last 2 years. We have raised equity financing from top tier investors including: Firstmark, Accomplice, Revolution Growth, Navitas and Juxtapose.
About the Role
Orchard’s engineering team values clarity, collaboration, and ownership. Our team builds the systems behind Orchard’s website and the tools that help agents reach new customers. We focus on helping people explore homes, book consultations, and connect with our agents. Our site serves over 150k unique visitors each month and sees about 700k pageviews. The team partners closely with marketing, product, and design to support new campaigns, track performance, and ensure the site is fast and reliable at scale.
You'll work on the systems that make this possible - backend, frontend, or both, depending on where the work takes you. That means building and improving APIs, data services, and integrations that support both customers and agents. Your work will touch many parts of the systems our team owns. We build and maintain the services that bring new customers into Orchard, from the public website and intake flows, to scheduling and consultation booking. We also support the tools that help our agents work with those customers, like managing and syncing leads, powering outreach, and maintaining privacy and consent systems that keep customer data safe and compliant.
You’ll work closely with product managers, designers, engineers, and business stakeholders to plan and ship projects. The team is small and moves quickly, so you’ll have real ownership and visibility in your work. Most of our engineering work today is agent-driven: we use tools like Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, and Codex daily, and the job is less about typing code yourself and more about scoping the work well, directing AI tools effectively, and catching it when they get something wrong. We're looking for engineers who are good at that loop, not just comfortable with AI tools existing.
This is a full-time role that will report into our Senior Software Engineer and be based out of the New York office, where we are in office on Tuesdays and Wednesdays.
What You'll Do Here
Build and maintain the services and interfaces that power Orchard's website and internal tools. Most of our stack uses Qwik on the frontend and Python with Postgres and OpenSearch on the backend, though some other services use React and TypeScript.
Work with product and design to turn ideas into clear, well-scoped projects.
Debug and improve core services to make them faster and more reliable as we prepare for national growth over the next 12-18 months.
Ensure our systems can scale smoothly as our user base continues to grow.
Write clean, tested code that’s easy to understand and maintain.
Help improve developer workflows, testing, and documentation.
Take part in on-call rotations and own the systems you build.
Work with a small team that values communication, trust, and practical solutions.
Use AI coding tools like Claude Code, Copilot, and Codex as part of your daily workflow to build and ship features efficiently.
Comfortable reviewing code you didn't write
We'd Love to Hear From You if You Have
At least 2+ years of experience as a software engineer.
Strong skills in at least one language relevant to our stack (Python, TypeScript, or Go), with solid knowledge of APIs and data modeling.
Experience with tools like AWS, Postgres, SQL, Kafka, Airflow, Docker, or CircleCI is a plus.
Experience directing AI coding tools effectively
A low-ego, problem-solving mindset. You take ownership, improve what you touch, and ask for help when something doesn't add up.
Interest in a hands-on team where engineers ship quickly and have real impact.
For NYC residents only: The pay range for this position in New York City is $130,000-$150,000/year. The actual base pay offered may vary within the range provided depending on job-related knowledge, skills, experience, and location. Stock options and other incentive pay may be provided as part of the compensation package, in addition to a full range of medical, financial, and/or other benefits, depending on the position offered. DATA ANALYST, PAYMENTS
Current is a leading US-based fintech company dedicated to empowering individuals to achieve their financial goals. We're committed to providing innovative and accessible financial solutions, and data plays a crucial role in driving our success. We're looking for a talented and passionate Data Analyst to join our Payments team and help us leverage data to optimize our operations, enhance our products, and deliver exceptional customer experiences.
ABOUT THE ROLE
As a Data Analyst on the Payments team, you'll be at the forefront of shaping our understanding of customer behavior, payments product performance, and operational efficiency. You'll work closely with product managers, engineers, and other stakeholders to translate business questions into actionable insights. Your work will directly impact key decisions related to our banking products, features, and overall strategy.
RESPONSIBILITIES
Analyze large datasets to uncover trends, patterns, and improvement opportunities in banking products and services.
Build and maintain dashboards and reports to track KPIs and deliver clear insights to stakeholders.
Conduct discovery and deep-dive analyses to support data-driven decision-making.
Partner with product managers and engineers to define and measure the success of features and initiatives.
Design and evaluate experiments to optimize products and enhance customer experience.
Monitor and analyze customer behavior across deposits, transactions, and other banking activities.
Deliver actionable insights to leadership on emerging trends and innovation opportunities.
Work with analytics and backend engineers to ensure accessible, accurate, and high-quality data.
Communicate findings and recommendations effectively to both technical and non-technical audiences.
Continuously improve data analysis processes and methodologies.
Uphold data integrity, accuracy, and governance across analytics pipelines.
Support production analytics and fraud response through participation in on-call rotations.
REQUIREMENTS
Bachelor's degree in a quantitative field such as Analytics, Statistics, Economics, Computer Science, or a related field.
Experience as a data analyst for 3+ years, ideally in B2C, financial services, or technology.
Strong proficiency in SQL and experience working with relational databases (e.g., Bigquery, Snowflake, Redshift, etc).
Proficient in utilizing data visualization tools like Tableau, Looker, or other similar platforms.
Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills with a strong attention to detail.
Ability to communicate complex data insights clearly and effectively to both technical and non-technical audiences.
Strong business acumen and the ability to translate business questions into data analysis plans.
Experience with A/B testing and experimental design.
Working experience with Python for data analysis.
ADDITIONAL DESIRED SKILLS AND QUALIFICATIONS
Familiarity with the fintech industry and banking products is a plus.
Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, collaborative environment.
Exposure to dimensional modeling concepts to power meaningful analytics.
Experience building data pipelines in dbt.
Familiarity with machine learning techniques and predictive analytics is a plus.
Experience modeling data using dbt.
This role has a base salary range of $130,000 - $175,000. Compensation is determined based on experience, skill level, and qualifications, which are assessed during the interview process. Current offers a competitive total rewards package which includes base salary, equity, and comprehensive benefits.

Employee Assistance Programs focused on mental health

About Crunchyroll
Founded by fans, Crunchyroll delivers the art and culture of anime to a passionate community. We super-serve over 100 million anime and manga fans across 200+ countries and territories, and help them connect with the stories and characters they crave. Whether that experience is online or in-person, streaming video, theatrical, games, merchandise, events and more, it’s powered by the anime content we all love.
Join our team, and help us shape the future of anime!
About the role
As a Software Engineer II on the Mobile Monetization team, you will contribute to the improvement of end-to-end monetization experiences on Crunchyroll’s Android and Apple apps. Our goal is to increase subscription and add-on revenue while preserving fan trust and product quality. You will take ownership of key features and improvements, ensuring high-quality code, performance, and user experience. You'll collaborate with Engineering, Product, Design, and Program Management to deliver scalable and reliable solutions that delight millions of anime fans. Contribute to the design and implementation of Android features that enhance our streaming apps across supported platforms.
Collaborate on solutions that improve code maintainability, user experience, and overall app performance.
Identify technical debt, performance bottlenecks, or reliability issues, and work with engineering leadership and your team to address them.
Maintain high standards for code quality and engineering best practices across the Android stack.
Participate in design discussions and code reviews, contributing to a strong team culture of technical excellence.
Support operational excellence through sustainable on-call practices and a focus on reducing long-term toil.
Stay current with industry trends, tools, and best practices in Android development to ensure our apps remain competitive and modern.
This is a hybrid role (3 days in the office per week) that reports to an Engineering Manager, Mobile Monetization in the Fan Experience Engineering Organization. We are considering applicants for the location of San Francisco.
Core Areas of Responsibility
Implement Android features that directly impact the Crunchyroll user experience across multiple platforms.
Collaborate cross-functionally in technical solutions to align with product goals and customer needs.
Be responsible for feature development as an owner, with a focus on quality, performance, and scalability.
Contribute to team operations, including code reviews, on-call support, and technical planning.
Continuously seek opportunities to improve engineering practices, reduce tech debt, and enhance development efficiency.
About You
We get excited about candidates, like you, because…
You have 2+ years of experience developing Android applications using Kotlin.
You have hands-on experience building production apps with Jetpack libraries such as Compose.
You have a working knowledge of testing frameworks like Espresso and understand the value of unit, integration, and E2E testing.
You are familiar with Android architecture patterns and have applied them to create maintainable and scalable codebases.
You have contributed to consumer-facing mobile applications at scale, ideally with multimedia or streaming experiences.
You have experience debugging complex issues and navigating large, modular codebases using established engineering best practices.
You possess a strong grasp of Git workflows and are comfortable working in modern CI/CD practices.
You are familiar with Agile methodologies and working within a cross-functional team setup.
You have participated in an on-call rotation and understand what it means to build resilient systems that reduce operational burden over time.
You are test-driven and have experience using agentic tools to enhance development efficiency.
About the Team
The Fan Experience Engineering Organization is a global team of engineers passionate about delivering high-quality experiences across all of Crunchyroll’s supported platforms, including Apple, Android, Roku, and more. Our Mobile Monetization team plays a key role in contributing towards revenue and reducing churn through better lifecycle management. We work closely with cross-functional partners to develop scalable features that serve millions of anime fans around the world. The work we do is front and center to Crunchyroll’s success and directly contributes to the growth of our platform and our audience.
Why you will love working at Crunchyroll
In addition to getting to work with fun, passionate and inspired colleagues, you will also enjoy the following benefits and perks:
Receive a great compensation package including salary plus performance bonus earning potential, paid annually.
Flexible time off policies allowing you to take the time you need to be your whole self.
Generous medical, dental, vision, STD, LTD, and life insurance
Health Saving Account HSA program
Health care and dependent care FSA
401(k) plan, with employer match
Employer paid commuter benefit
Support program for new parents
Pet insurance and some of our offices are pet friendly!
